messages:
elena: Quick sync: streaming semantics decision needed. Target: pick transport + delta shape + finish reasons. Why: 2 pilot customers need streaming by mid-Apr.

sam: Which constraints? mobile proxies + browsers + enterprise firewalls.

elena: Yes. Also function-calls streaming compatibility + structured JSON streaming for extractor pipelines.

raj: My 2c: prefer SSE default for hosted API (simplicity + proxies), WS opt-in for low-latency multiplexing. Mobile: SSE has better proxy haircuts but websocket's binary framing helps big deltas.

chen: We need delta schema: small text diffs vs object patches. Customers want both: plain text deltas for chat, object deltas for structured outputs. Proposal: 'delta' envelope with optional 'patch' field.

sam: Sketch:
```json
{"type":"delta","role":"assistant","content":"The quick","finishReason":null}
{"type":"delta","content":" brown","finishReason":null}
{"type":"final","content":" fox","finishReason":"complete"}
```

lisa: UX note: clients expect partial function-call args streamed — we must decide streaming functioncall or only stream tokens then final function call.

raj: Streaming function call complicates rollback. I'd prefer stream tokens for function calls and final 'function_call' event with full args. If someone needs streaming args we can produce 'arg_delta' events behind feature flag.

elena: Launch gates: (1) SDKs updated (python/js mobile), (2) perf SLOs p50<200ms token, p95<1s per chunk in pilots, (3) two pilot customers + infra fallback (non-streaming model).

sam: Ops: fallback policy: if SSE fails, auto-retry on REST final-only with reason 'fallback:transport' included.

deploy-bot: canary of stream proxy config rolling tonight at 22:00 UTC :rocket:

chen: Finish reasons list proposal: 'complete', 'cancelled', 'error', 'truncated'. Also include 'soft_stop' for policy-triggered truncation so clients can show banner.

lisa: Agree add 'soft_stop'. Need stable enum values and docs.

elena: Priority: MVP: support text deltas + final finishReason 'complete' + SSE default. Stretch: ws multiplexing + structured object deltas + streaming function args.

raj: Question on resume: do we support resume tokens? Customers asked. It's heavy. Proposal: postpone resume to post-MVP.

sam: Agree. Add to roadmap: resume token V2 for Q3.

elena: Action items: @sam update SDK PR with SSE client example; @raj write runtime fallback doc; @chen add delta schema proto; @lisa write UX patterns. Deadline: EOD Thu.

sam: :thumbsup: will PR today.

raj: :eyes: will draft.

lisa: I'll sketch UX flows for partial function calls.
